title: Discovery of Interpretable Surrogates via Agentic AI: Application to Gravitational Waves
abstract: arXiv:2605.11280v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fast surrogate models for expensive simulations are now essential across the sciences, yet they typically operate as black boxes. We present \texttt{GWAgent}, a large language model (LLM)-based workflow that constructs interpretable analytic surrogates directly from simulation data. Surrogate modeling is well suited to agentic workflows because candidate models can be quantitatively validated against ground-truth simulations at each iteration. As a demonstration, we build a surrogate for gravitational waveforms from eccentric binary black hole mergers. We show that providing the agent with a physics-informed domain ansatz substantially improves output model accuracy. The resulting analytic surrogate attains a median Advanced LIGO mismatch of $6.9\times10^{-4}$ together with an $\sim 8.4\times$ speedup in waveform evaluation, surpassing both symbolic regression and conventional machine learning baselines. translated_title: 通过智能体AI发现可解释的代理模型：在引力波中的应用
translated_abstract: 针对昂贵模拟的快速代理模型如今在各科学领域已不可或缺，但它们通常以黑箱方式运行。我们提出了GWAgent，这是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的工作流程，能够直接从模拟数据构建可解释的解析代理模型。代理建模非常适合智能体工作流程，因为候选模型可以在每次迭代中通过与真实模拟进行定量验证。作为演示，我们为偏心双黑洞并合的引力波形构建了代理模型。我们表明，为智能体提供基于物理的领域拟设可显著提高输出模型的精度。所得的解析代理模型达到了6.9×10⁻⁴的Advanced LIGO中位失配度，同时波形评估速度提升约8.4倍，超越了符号回归和传统机器学习基线。除了产生可解释的模型之外……
tldr: 提出了基于大语言模型的智能体工作流程GWAgent，可直接从模拟数据构建可解释的解析代理模型，在偏心双黑洞并合引力波形建模中实现了Advanced LIGO中位失配6.9×10⁻⁴且波形评估速度提升约8.4倍，性能超越符号回归和传统机器学习方法。
en_tdlr: We present GWAgent, an LLM-based agentic workflow that constructs interpretable analytic surrogates directly from simulation data, achieving a median Advanced LIGO mismatch of 6.9×10⁻⁴ with ~8.4× waveform evaluation speedup for eccentric binary black hole mergers, surpassing both symbolic regression and conventional machine learning baselines.
